quotes.title: TOI-715
quotes.card: TOI-715 is a red dwarf star located 42 parsecs (140 ly) from the Earth in the constellation Volans, very close to the southern celestial pole.
quotes.introduction: It hosts one confirmed exoplanet, named TOI-715 b, a super-Earth orbiting in its habitable zone.
